LanguageData.AOC17CE_UnlimitedIntakeDescription: Choose a direction to face while a swirling intake field draws in bullets for 5 seconds. It catches all incoming bullets within 3 cells, including friendly fire, without a projectile-count limit. An activation that catches at least one bullet produces one bag of waste in total; catching no bullets produces no waste. The interception sound rises in pitch as more bullets are caught. Uses one chemfuel charge. Cooldown: 10 seconds from activation.
